title: Knowing Scott Joplin's family in Texarkana
summary: He knew Joplin's family and went to school with a relative, and later learned Joplin's tunes like Maple Leaf Rag.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I remember that Scott Joplin, I think, came from there, who wrote all the ragtime. Did you ever hear him when you were young or know anything about him down there?

I didn't. I used to see him, and I knew his family very well. I went to school with S.A.D. Joplin. Oh, a relative. A relative. And I know Willie had turned time. He later on, he married S.A.D., and he played the trombone. And only later on I became more acquainted with Joplin's works by playing the Maple Leaf Rag and other tunes that he wrote.
